name: Signitic
summary: Email signature management for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365: central templates, per-entity branding, and clickable banner campaigns with click statistics. ISO 27001 certified and hosted in Europe.
best_for: European organisations of roughly twenty people and up, on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, that want every signature centrally controlled and the banner slot run as a measurable campaign channel — and that need EU hosting and ISO 27001 on the record
skip_if: you have fewer than twenty employees, where the free plan is the whole offer and the paid tier cannot be bought below its 20-licence minimum, or your people sit on Outlook 2013-2021 or Apple Mail and would land on the agent with its plain signatures rather than the add-in
honest_knock: The homepage sells deployment 'without going through IT', and Signitic's own help centre contradicts that on every path in. Connecting Google Workspace is possible only from the Super Admin profile, and if that admin ever changes you have to reconnect or call support. Microsoft 365 needs an Azure Active Directory administrator account. Rolling out the Outlook add-in — the fuller of the two Microsoft options — needs a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator plus the Exchange Administrator role carrying the ReadWriteMailbox permission, must not be installed by end users themselves, and can take up to 72 hours to appear in people's Outlook. Marketing does keep the keys afterwards, which is the real promise; it does not get them without IT first. The add-in also needs a Microsoft 365 Outlook licence at version 16.0.14026.20000 or later, so Outlook 2013 to 2021 and Apple Mail fall back to the Signitic agent, which pushes plain signatures instead.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price read 2026-09-14) Signitic's own pricing page, read in euros from a European connection, carries three tiers. Free covers organisations up to 19 employees and gives one signature template, one banner campaign, and a Signitic badge at the bottom of every signature that the plan does not let you remove. The paid tier — the card the page marks Most popular — is €1 per user with a minimum of 20 licences, and it is where the caps come off: unlimited signature templates, unlimited banner campaigns, a custom subdomain for deliverability, multi-entity segmentation, A/B testing with click statistics, and no badge. That card prints the euro and the word user but never a period; the ROI calculator further down the same page settles it, pricing 100 employees at 1 200 € a year, which is twelve euros per user per year — so the euro is monthly, and the 20-licence minimum puts the real floor at twenty euros a month. The third tier is Custom and carries no public figure: advanced permission management, campaign targeting from CRM lists, HRIS/SFTP integration, vCard digital business cards and a dedicated support team all sit behind a quote. Registered non-profits are offered 50% off subject to an eligibility check.
